message.content: In the conversation, Wolfgang expresses a preference for a well-done meat patty in a classic American cheeseburger, stating "I think well-done is just safer and more flavorful." He further elaborates by saying, "Plus, I like a little char on my burger!" This indicates that Wolfgang enjoys the additional depth and flavor that comes with a well-done patty, despite acknowledging the safety concerns associated with medium-rare meat. His preference leans more towards the more cooked side, emphasizing the overall flavor profile he prefers in his burger.
